slides.title: Suite Judy Blue Eyes
slides.body: Crosby, Stills & Nash made their Woodstock debut as a new harmony unit under enormous attention.

slides.title: What you are watching
slides.body: The trio was still early in its public life when it stepped onto the Woodstock stage. Their close vocal blend offered a different kind of spectacle: precision, harmony, and the feeling of a band becoming visible in real time.
